figures.finding: Iceland reimburses 25% of production costs incurred there with no minimum spend and no cap, and 35% for productions spending at least ISK 350 million over 30 working days (10 of them shooting) with 50 or more crew taxed in Iceland, or for children's and youth content; applications go to the Icelandic Film Centre before production starts, and the law runs to 31 December 2028.

value.name: Reimbursement under Act No. 43/1999
value.base: costs incurred in Iceland deductible under the Income Tax Act

figures.applies: Iceland; feature films, TV series and documentaries; terms as Film in Iceland publishes them on 2026-11-01.

sources.said: Every feature film, TV series, and documentary that incurs production costs in Iceland qualifies for a 25% reimbursement. There is no minimum spend requirement and no cap on the total amount. … Production costs incurred in Iceland must be at least ISK 350 million. A minimum of 30 working days in Iceland, either shooting days or defined post-production days, of which at least 10 must be shooting days. At least 50 crew members working directly on the project for a minimum of 50 working days, with all salaries and contractor payments taxed in Iceland. … The current legislation is valid through 31 December 2028.

figures.finding: The Icelandic Film Fund (Kvikmyndasjóður) gives selective production grants only to Icelandic production companies, with no fixed maximum, after all other financing is closed; the 2027 budget bill gives it ISK 1,296.5 million, about 5% less than in 2026.

value.condition: financing from others fully closed before contract; contract before shooting

figures.applies: Iceland; feature films, shorts, documentaries and TV drama; budget bill tabled 8 September 2026.

sources.said: Til rekstrarliðar miðstöðvarinnar er áformað að verja 180,7 m.kr. en 1.296,5 m.kr. til Kvikmyndasjóðs. Samanburður við samþykkt fjárlög fyrra árs sýnir um 5% samdrátt í framlagi til Kvikmyndasjóðs milli ára.

Tímabundin vilyrði og framleiðslustyrkir eru aðeins veittir íslenskum framleiðslufyrirtækjum sem hafa kvikmyndagerð að meginstarfi. Afgreiðsla sjóðsins tekur að jafnaði allt að 10 - 12 vikur. … Skilyrði fyrir framleiðslustyrk er að fyrir liggi skriflegir samningar eða staðfestingar um að fjármögnun sé að fullu lokið hjá öðrum en Kvikmyndasjóði. … Hámarksupphæð Fer eftir umfangi verkefnis.
